title: Agora restart persistence probe cannot import services since 2026-09-15

regression_resolved.description: Deployment step 'Dev Agora restart persistence smoke under lease' failed deterministically since 2026-09-15: smoke script runs inside the container by absolute path with cleared PYTHONPATH, having only scripts/ and BFF_ROOT on sys.path. Commit 7b8f8ad3f added imports from services.research to agora.strategy_workshop.reconstruction, causing ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'services'. In addition, in PR #5924 Branch CI Gate run 35344342707, importing agora.governance.store eagerly triggered router.py in agora.governance.__init__.py requiring fastapi, which was missing in the CI runner.
regression_resolved.resolution: Configured scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py to prepend both BFF_ROOT and ROOT to sys.path with BFF_ROOT having precedence so agora resolves to the deployed container modules and services resolves to repository services. Made create_governance_router and run_reconstruction_worker lazy imported via __getattr__ in agora.governance.__init__.py and agora.strategy_workshop.__init__.py so importing durable stores does not trigger eager router/fastapi dependencies. Added fastapi to branch-ci.yml smoke job dependencies. Added scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py to Branch CI Gate under 'Run delivery diagnostics and exit-status regressions' alongside the other deploy helpers with explicit regression tests for standalone execution without PYTHONPATH, resolution of agora to deployed container modules, importing without fastapi, and CI execution.

owned: scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py: configure sys.path with BFF_ROOT at index 0 and ROOT at index 1

scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py: regression tests for standalone execution without PYTHONPATH, deployed container agora resolution, importing without fastapi, and branch-ci execution
.github/workflows/branch-ci.yml: include scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py in delivery diagnostics gate and add fastapi to smoke job dependencies
services/control-plane/bff/agora/governance/__init__.py: lazy import create_governance_router to prevent eager router/fastapi loading when importing store
services/control-plane/bff/agora/strategy_workshop/__init__.py: lazy import run_reconstruction_worker to prevent eager runner/operations/fastapi loading when importing store

criterion_2.statement: the agora package still resolves to the modules the deployed container serves rather than any other copy
criterion_2.evidence: Verified by test_agora_package_resolves_to_deployed_bff_modules: agora.__file__ resolves strictly to services/control-plane/bff/agora/__init__.py and not services/agora.

criterion_3.statement: the existing standalone import regression test passes and is executed by the branch gate that already guards the other deploy helpers
criterion_3.evidence: Verified by test_branch_ci_gate_executes_persistence_smoke_test, test_smoke_helper_and_governance_store_import_without_fastapi, test_branch_ci_gate_installs_fastapi_for_smoke_job, and branch-ci.yml: scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py is included in 'Run delivery diagnostics and exit-status regressions' and passes 10/10 tests.

criterion_4.statement: no production import is widened beyond what the probe itself needs
criterion_4.evidence: Production imports were not widened; lazy imports in agora.governance and agora.strategy_workshop narrow import footprints when only store modules are imported.
